events.summary: Worcester & Narragansett 20s/30s: Interchapter Social and Board Game Night at Lops Brewing 2026

location.title:
JOHNSTON BUILDING, 122 N Main St #
Woonsocket, RI

description.plain:
Tuesday, February 17, 2026 | 6:00 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UUN000002BIV72AO/
Join the Worcester and Narragansett chapters in a 20s and 30s interchapter social! Enjoy an evening of board games at Lops Brewing in Woonsocket, RI. You will to get to know others who are interested in the outdoors and meet good friends over drinks (alcoholic and non-alcoholic options available). This is a great opportunity to learn about upcoming trips and talk with trip leaders. Lops Brewing has connections to the White Mountains, so be sure to check them out in advance! The social starts at 6:00 pm, spots are limited.We welcome people of all skill levels and young folks with varying outdoor interests. If you are new to AMC, we'd love to meet you!

Friday, March 6, 2026 | 6:45 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UVX000000zapl2AA/
Before the ski season wraps up, join the Worcester 20s & 30s group for an evening of skiing/boarding at Mt. Wachusett on Friday, March 6th!We will be there for Session 4 (7pm - 9:30pm), but we will plan to meet fifteen minutes earlier at the lodge for introductions and coordination. All participants will be sent a screening form as the event approaches so the leader is aware of each participants skiing/boarding background. The plan is for groups to organically self-sort based on slopes of interest and level. The leader is happy to ski with any group!
